## Summary

Describe the user-visible or repository-level change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test:list`
- [ ] Live RX2GO tests were not run, or the exact approved suite/result is documented below.

## Safety review

- [ ] No passwords, tokens, cookies, browser sessions, private keys, or customer data are included.
- [ ] Runtime output remains ignored.
- [ ] Mutating behavior is unchanged or explicitly documented.
- [ ] Documentation describes implemented behavior only.
